110	def _public_json(value: Any, *, label: str) -> Any:
111	    """Copy JSON values while rejecting private capability material."""
112	
113	    if value is None or isinstance(value, (str, bool, int)):
114	        return value
115	    if isinstance(value, float):
116	        if not math.isfinite(value):
117	            raise CapabilityError(f"{label} contains a non-finite number")
118	        return value
119	    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
120	        result: dict[str, Any] = {}
121	        for key, item in value.items():
122	            if not isinstance(key, str) or not key:
123	                raise CapabilityError(f"{label} has a non-string key")
124	            normalized_key = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", key.casefold())
125	            if any(part in normalized_key for part in _AUTHORITY_KEY_PARTS):
126	                raise CapabilityError(f"{label} contains private capability material")
127	            result[key] = _public_json(item, label=label)
128	        return {key: result[key] for key in sorted(result)}
129	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
130	        return [_public_json(item, label=label) for item in value]
131	    raise CapabilityError(f"{label} is not canonical JSON")
132	
133	
134	def _freeze(value: Any) -> Any:
135	    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
136	        return MappingProxyType({key: _freeze(item) for key, item in value.items()})
137	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
138	        return tuple(_freeze(item) for item in value)
139	    return value
140	
141	
142	def _thaw(value: Any) -> Any:
143	    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
144	        return {key: _thaw(item) for key, item in value.items()}
145	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
146	        return [_thaw(item) for item in value]
147	    return value
148	
149	
150	def canonical_json_bytes(value: Any) -> bytes:
151	    """Return the one compact, deterministic representation used by this seam."""
152	
153	    try:
154	        return json.dumps(
155	            _public_json(value, label="canonical value"),
156	            sort_keys=True,
157	            separators=(",", ":"),
158	            ensure_ascii=False,
159	            allow_nan=False,
160	        ).encode("utf-8")
161	    except (TypeError, ValueError, UnicodeError) as exc:
162	        raise CapabilityError("value is not canonical JSON") from exc
163	
164	
165	def canonical_sha256(value: Any) -> str:
166	    return hashlib.sha256(canonical_json_bytes(value)).hexdigest()
167	
168	
169	def _identifier(value: Any, label: str) -> str:
170	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not _IDENTIFIER.fullmatch(value):
171	        raise CapabilityDenied(
172	            "INVALID_IDENTITY", f"{label} is not a bounded identifier", stage="request"
173	        )
174	    return value
175	
176	
177	def _finite_time(value: Any, label: str) -> float:
178	    if (
179	        isinstance(value, bool)
180	        or not isinstance(value, (int, float))
181	        or not math.isfinite(float(value))
182	    ):
183	        raise CapabilityDenied(
184	            "INVALID_EXPIRY", f"{label} is not finite", stage="request"
185	        )
186	    return float(value)
187	
188	
189	def _process_identity(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
190	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != _IDENTITY_KEYS:
191	        raise CapabilityDenied(
192	            "INVALID_IDENTITY",
193	            f"{label} is not a closed process identity",
194	            stage="request",
195	        )
196	    pid = value.get("pid")
197	    if not isinstance(pid, int) or isinstance(pid, bool) or pid <= 0:
198	        raise CapabilityDenied(
199	            "INVALID_IDENTITY", f"{label} has an invalid PID", stage="request"
200	        )
201	    if not all(
202	        isinstance(value.get(key), str) and bool(value[key])
203	        for key in ("created_utc", "creation_identity")
204	    ):
205	        raise CapabilityDenied(
206	            "INVALID_IDENTITY",
207	            f"{label} has an incomplete creation identity",
208	            stage="request",
209	        )
210	    return {
211	        "pid": pid,
212	        "created_utc": value["created_utc"],
213	        "creation_identity": value["creation_identity"],
214	    }
215	
216	
217	def _adapter_identity(value: Any, label: str = "adapter identity") -> dict[str, str]:
218	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != _ADAPTER_IDENTITY_KEYS:
219	        raise CapabilityError(f"{label} is not a closed adapter identity")
220	    result = {key: value[key] for key in _ADAPTER_IDENTITY_KEYS}
221	    if not all(isinstance(item, str) and item for item in result.values()):
222	        raise CapabilityError(f"{label} is incomplete")
223	    return {
224	        "adapter_id": result["adapter_id"],
225	        "adapter_version": result["adapter_version"],
226	    }
227	
228	
229	def _mapping(value: Any, label: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
230	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
231	        raise CapabilityError(f"{label} is not an object")
232	    copied = _public_json(value, label=label)
233	    if not isinstance(copied, dict):
234	        raise CapabilityError(f"{label} is not an object")
235	    return copied

258	    @classmethod
259	    def from_record(cls, value: Any, *, now_monotonic: float) -> "CapabilityRequest":
260	        if not isinstance(value, Mapping) or set(value) != {
261	            "schema",
262	            "request_id",
263	            "lane_id",
264	            "controller_identity",
265	            "capability",
266	            "action",
267	            "arguments",
268	            "resources",

270	            "route",
271	        }:

273	                "REQUEST_NOT_CLOSED", "request schema is not closed", stage="request"
274	            )
275	        if value.get("schema") != REQUEST_SCHEMA or value.get("route") != "capability":
276	            raise CapabilityDenied(
277	                "MIXED_ROUTE",
278	                "record is not a capability-route request",
279	                stage="request",
280	            )
281	        request_id = _identifier(value.get("request_id"), "request_id")
282	        lane_id = _identifier(value.get("lane_id"), "lane_id")
283	        capability = _identifier(value.get("capability"), "capability")
284	        action = _identifier(value.get("action"), "action")
285	        identity = _process_identity(
286	            value.get("controller_identity"), "controller_identity"
287	        )
288	        arguments = _mapping(value.get("arguments"), "arguments")
289	        raw_resources = value.get("resources")

291	            raise CapabilityDenied(

296	        resources: list[str] = []

302	                    "duplicate resource is not canonical",
303	                    stage="request",
304	                )
305	            resources.append(resource)

307	        if expiry <= now_monotonic:

309	                "EXPIRED_REQUEST", "request is already expired", stage="request"
310	            )
311	        return cls(
312	            request_id=request_id,
313	            lane_id=lane_id,
314	            controller_identity=identity,
315	            capability=capability,
316	            action=action,
317	            arguments=arguments,
318	            resources=tuple(sorted(resources)),
319	            expires_monotonic=expiry,
320	        )

328	            "capability": self.capability,

1221	        reasons: list[str] = []
1222	        if cleanup.proved is not True:
1223	            reasons.append("adapter did not prove cleanup")
1224	        boundary = cleanup.boundary if isinstance(cleanup.boundary, Mapping) else {}
1225	        if boundary.get("complete") is not True:
1226	            reasons.append("owned cleanup boundary is incomplete")
1227	        if cleanup.identities:
1228	            reasons.append("cleanup retains live or unresolved identities")
1229	        for key in ("errors", "boundary_errors"):
1230	            value = boundary.get(key)
1231	            if value not in (None, [], (), ""):
1232	                reasons.append(f"cleanup boundary reports {key}")
1233	        for key in ("live_members", "live_identities", "members"):
1234	            value = boundary.get(key)
1235	            if value not in (None, [], (), ""):
1236	                reasons.append(f"cleanup boundary reports {key}")
1237	        details = cleanup.details if isinstance(cleanup.details, Mapping) else {}
1238	        stack: list[tuple[str, Any]] = [
1239	            (str(key).casefold(), value) for key, value in details.items()
1240	        ]
1241	        while stack:
1242	            key, value = stack.pop()
1243	            normalized = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", key)
1244	            if (
1245	                normalized not in {"dispatchfailed", "launchstarted"}
1246	                and any(
1247	                    token in normalized for token in ("error", "failure", "unresolved")
1248	                )
1249	                and value not in (None, False, "", [], ())
1250	            ):
1251	                reasons.append(f"cleanup details report {key}")
1252	            if (
1253	                normalized
1254	                in {

1256	                    "helpersstopped",
1257	                    "helperthreadsstopped",
1258	                    "stderrlogcomplete",
1259	                }
1260	                and value is not True
1261	            ):

1263	            if normalized == "stopped" and value is not True:

"""Compatibility detection: canonical invocation schema & validation rules.

Phase 1 / Area 1.A detection suite.  Every test fabricates an input, mutates
exactly one field, and asserts the real validator's rejection (or documents the
actual behavior when it differs from the plan).  No provider subprocess is
launched and no harness source module is modified.

The canonical baseline is copied verbatim from ``test_s2_contract._canonical``
so the two suites share the exact fixture shape.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import tempfile
import unittest
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from orchestrator_harness.invocation import (
    CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
    CanonicalInvocation,
    InvocationValidationError,
    _digest,
    _strings,
    adapt_coding_v1,
    adapt_invocation,
    parse_canonical_invocation,
)
import orchestrator_harness.lane_controller as controller
from orchestrator_harness.lane_controller import (
    InvocationError,
    _canonical_resume_admission_path,
    _canonical_resume_claims_accepted,
    _classify_provider_operations,
    _persist_canonical_acceptance,
    _provider_handoff_identity,
    _read_canonical_prior_status,
    _reject_ambiguous_coding_aliases,
    _validate_canonical_output_paths,
    isolated_coding_child_environment,
    load_invocation,
)
from orchestrator_harness.profile import RuntimeProfile
from orchestrator_harness.prompt_bundle import (
    PROMPT_BUNDLE_SCHEMA,
    prompt_bundle_record_from_paths,
)
from orchestrator_harness.provider import ProviderAdapterError
from orchestrator_harness.task import TASK_CARD_SCHEMA, record_sha256

CODING_INVOCATION_SCHEMA = "orchestrator-coding-invocation/v1"


class CompatInvocationRulesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _canonical(self, root: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, object], object]:
        """One valid ``orchestrator-worker-invocation/v1`` baseline (s2-identical)."""
        run = root / "run"
        workspace = run / ".agent-workspace"
        workspace.mkdir(parents=True)
        runtime = root / "runtime"
        runtime.mkdir()
        prompt_a = run / "prompt-a.md"
        prompt_b = run / "prompt-b.md"
        prompt_a.write_bytes(b"workflow\n")
        prompt_b.write_bytes(b"task\n")
        card = {
            "schema": TASK_CARD_SCHEMA,
            "card_id": "card-1",
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "stage_cohort_id": "cohort-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "objective": "Do the bounded task",
            "revision": "r1",
        }
        profile = RuntimeProfile(
            "profile-1",
            "implementer",
            "claude-code",
            "claude-test",
            ("Read",),
            ("repo",),
            ("resource-1",),
            ("CLAUDE_CODE_TEST",),
            ("WORKFLOW_TEST_FLAG",),
        )
        bundle = prompt_bundle_record_from_paths(
            workflow_id="workflow-1",
            task_card_id="card-1",
            profile_id="profile-1",
            paths=(("instructions", prompt_a), ("task", prompt_b)),
            run_root=run,
        )
        value: dict[str, object] = {
            "schema": CANONICAL_INVOCATION_SCHEMA,
            "action": "start",
            "run_root": str(run),
            "runtime_root": str(runtime),
            "lane_id": "lane-1",
            "worker_invocation_id": "worker-1",
            "cohort_id": "cohort-1",
            "workflow": {"id": "workflow-1", "version": "1"},
            "task_card": {
                "id": "card-1",
                "revision": "r1",
                "sha256": record_sha256(card),
            },
            "role": "implementer",
            "provider": {
                "id": "claude-code",
                "model": "claude-test",
                "command": ["synthetic-claude"],
                "permission_mode": "default",
                "allowed_tools": ["Read"],
            },
            "profile": profile.to_record(),
            "prompt_bundle": bundle,
            "output_paths": {
                "status": str(workspace / "worker_controller.status.json"),
                "jsonl": str(workspace / "worker_provider.jsonl"),
                "stderr": str(workspace / "worker.stderr.log"),

subprocess is launched and no harness source module is modified.

The fixture helpers (``OWNER``, ``_request``, ``_approval``, ``_Verifier``,
``_Claims``, ``_OrderedAdapter``, ``_broker``) are copied from
``test_s5_capability_broker`` so both suites share the exact seam shapes.

Two items carry KNOWN plan-vs-reality divergences and are pinned as green
tests with the FINDING noted in the module docstring (the coordinator files
them in ``evidence/FINDINGS.md``):

* FINDING F2B-L4-1 (note): the plan says the permit is a single/bounded-use
  value with a self-contained counter.  Reality: ``CapabilityPermit`` is an
  immutable in-memory value with NO self-contained use counter; bounded use is
  enforced by the broker via (a) idempotent terminal-result reuse for an exact
  retry and (b) replay refusal (``REPLAY_MISMATCH`` / durable
  ``APPROVAL_REPLAY``).  See ``test_L4_bounded_single_use_grant``.

* FINDING F2B-L7-1 (note): the plan says pointing at a missing adapter raises
  ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` to the caller.  Reality: the broker catches
  an adapter's ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` raised from ``observe`` and
  returns a DENIED result with reason ``SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE`` -- the typed
  exception does NOT propagate out of ``execute``.  See
  ``test_L7_fail_closed_paths_and_no_permit_leak``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import unittest
from dataclasses import fields as dataclass_fields
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from typing import Any

from orchestrator_harness.capability_broker import (
    APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
    CLEANUP_SCHEMA,
    RESULT_SCHEMA,
    AdapterResult,
    CapabilityAdapterError,
    CapabilityAdapterUnavailable,
    CapabilityApproval,
    CapabilityBroker,
    CapabilityDenied,
    CapabilityError,
    CapabilityPermit,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilitySnapshot,
    CleanupEvidence,
    FakeCapabilityAdapter,
    canonical_json_bytes,
)

OWNER = {
    "pid": 321,
    "created_utc": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "creation_identity": "fake:321",
}


class _Verifier:
    def verify(self, payload: bytes, signature: str, public_key: str) -> bool:
        return bool(payload and signature and public_key)


class _Claims:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        events: list[str],
        *,
        owner: dict[str, Any] = OWNER,
    ) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.events = events
        self.owner = dict(owner)
        self._held: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.retained = False

    @property
    def held(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [dict(self._held[key]) for key in sorted(self._held)]

    def acquire_all(self, resources: list[str], *, on_wait) -> None:
        self.events.append("claim")
        for resource in sorted(resources):
            self._held[resource] = {
                "schema": "fake-resource-claim/v1",
                "resource": resource,
                "path": str(self.root / f"{resource}.claim"),
                "owner": dict(self.owner),
                "boundary_state": "NOT_ARMED",
                "boundary_may_exist": False,
            }

    def arm_boundary(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("arm")
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "ARMED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = True
        return []

    def retain_boundary(self, *, boundary, identities) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("retain")
        self.retained = True
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "RETAINED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = False
        return []

    def release_all(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("release")
        self._held.clear()
        return []


class _OrderedAdapter(FakeCapabilityAdapter):
    def __init__(self, events: list[str], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__({"synthetic": ("read",)}, **kwargs)
        self.events = events

    def cleanup(self, permit, dispatch_result, failure):
        self.events.append("cleanup")
        return super().cleanup(permit, dispatch_result, failure)


def _request(
    *,
    request_id: str = "request-1",
    arguments: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    expiry: float = 100.0,
    resources: list[str] | None = None,
    lane_id: str = "lane-a",
    capability: str = "synthetic",
    action: str = "read",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": "orchestrator-capability-request/v1",
        "request_id": request_id,
        "lane_id": lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(OWNER),
        "capability": capability,
        "action": action,
        "arguments": dict(arguments or {"value": "safe"}),
        "resources": list(resources or ["resource-a"]),
        "expires_monotonic": expiry,
        "route": "capability",
    }


def _approval(
    request: CapabilityRequest,
    snapshot,
    *,
    approval_id: str = "approval-1",
    expires: float = 90.0,
    snapshot_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
        "approval_id": approval_id,
        "request_id": request.request_id,
        "request_sha256": request.sha256,
        "lane_id": request.lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(request.controller_identity),
        "capability": request.capability,
        "action": request.action,
        "arguments": dict(request.arguments),
        "resources": list(request.resources),
        "snapshot_id": snapshot.snapshot_id,
        "snapshot_sha256": snapshot_sha256 or snapshot.sha256,
        "policy": {"policy": "synthetic-v1"},
        "issued_monotonic": 1.0,
        "expires_monotonic": expires,
        "decision": "approve",
        "public_key": "fake-public-key",
        "signature": "fake-signature",
    }


def _broker(
    adapter,
    claims,
    *,
    now: float = 10.0,
    events: list[str] | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
) -> CapabilityBroker:
    return CapabilityBroker(
        adapter,
        approval_verifier=_Verifier(),
        policy_verifier=lambda request, snapshot, approval: True,
        identity_provider=lambda: dict(OWNER),
        claims_factory=lambda lane, request_id: claims,
        state_root=state_root,
        clock=lambda: now,
        evidence_sink=(
            lambda record: (
                events.append(f"published:{record['state']}")
                if events is not None
                else None
            )
        ),
    )


class CompatCapabilityBrokerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _approval_for(
        self, request_value: dict[str, Any], adapter: FakeCapabilityAdapter
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = CapabilityRequest.from_record(request_value, now_monotonic=0.0)
        snapshot = adapter.observe(request)
        return _approval(request, snapshot)

    # L1 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L1_request_construction_closed_shape_and_reason_codes(self) -> None:
        valid = _request()
        parsed = CapabilityRequest.from_record(valid, now_monotonic=0.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(parsed, CapabilityRequest)
        self.assertEqual("capability", parsed.route)
        self.assertEqual(("resource-a",), parsed.resources)
        self.assertEqual(
            parsed.to_record(),
            CapabilityRequest.from_record(
                parsed.to_record(), now_monotonic=0.0
            ).to_record(),
        )

        cases: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any], str]] = [
            ("not_closed_extra", {**valid, "extra": True}, "REQUEST_NOT_CLOSED"),
            (
                "not_closed_missing",
                {key: value for key, value in valid.items() if key != "route"},
                "REQUEST_NOT_CLOSED",
            ),
            ("mixed_route", {**valid, "route": "coding"}, "MIXED_ROUTE"),
            ("empty_resources", {**valid, "resources": []}, "INVALID_RESOURCES"),
            (
                "duplicate_resources",
                {**valid, "resources": ["resource-a", "resource-a"]},
                "DUPLICATE_RESOURCE",
            ),
            ("expired", {**valid, "expires_monotonic": 0.0}, "EXPIRED_REQUEST"),
            (
                "bad_request_id",
                {**valid, "request_id": "not an identifier"},
                "INVALID_IDENTITY",
            ),
            (
                "bad_capability",
                {**valid, "capability": "bad!"},
                "INVALID_IDENTITY",
            ),
        ]
        for name, value, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityDenied) as context:
                    CapabilityRequest.from_record(value, now_monotonic=0.0)
                self.assertEqual(expected, context.exception.reason_code)
                self.assertIsInstance(context.exception, CapabilityError)

    # L2 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L2_snapshot_point_in_time_capture_and_immutability(self) -> None:
        parsed = CapabilityRequest.from_record(_request(), now_monotonic=0.0)
        snapshot = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)}).observe(parsed)
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, CapabilitySnapshot)

        # The frozen dataclass rejects attribute assignment.
        with self.assertRaises(
            (dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError, AttributeError, TypeError)
        ):
            snapshot.snapshot_id = "x"  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Nested mappings are frozen MappingProxyType instances.
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot.identity, type(parsed.arguments))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            snapshot.identity["k"] = 1  # type: ignore[index]
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            snapshot.resource_identities["resource-a"]["revision"] = "nope"  # type: ignore[index]

        # The snapshot round-trips through from_record byte-stably.
        record = snapshot.to_record()
        self.assertEqual(
            record, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).to_record()
        )
        self.assertEqual(snapshot.sha256, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).sha256)

        # from_record rejects a non-closed shape / wrong schema.
        open_record = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "schema"}
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
            CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(open_record)
        wrong_schema = dict(record)
        wrong_schema["schema"] = "bogus-snapshot/v1"
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
            CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(wrong_schema)

    # L3 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L3_mediated_approval_gate_admits_and_denies(self) -> None:
        # Approve path: exact request+snapshot binding reaches a PASS.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, len(adapter.permits))

        # Deny path: decision != "approve" is refused at parse time and by
        # the broker, with NO permit ever constructed or dispatched.
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        deny = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
        deny["decision"] = "deny"
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityDenied) as context:
            CapabilityApproval.from_record(deny)
        self.assertEqual("APPROVAL_DENIED", context.exception.reason_code)

        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, deny)
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "APPROVAL_DENIED", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

    # L4 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L4_bounded_single_use_grant_actual_broker_mechanism(self) -> None:
        # FINDING F2B-L4-1 (note): the plan describes a per-permit bounded-use
        # counter on the permit value.  Reality pins a broker-enforced grant:
        # the permit is an immutable in-memory value with NO self-contained use
        # counter; bounded use is (a) idempotent terminal-result reuse for an
        # exact retry and (b) replay refusal when the request is reused under
        # changed semantics.  No per-permit counter is asserted.
        permit_field_names = {field.name for field in dataclass_fields(CapabilityPermit)}
        self.assertNotIn("use_count", permit_field_names)
        self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", permit_field_names)

        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            broker = _broker(adapter, claims)
            request = _request()
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = broker.execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)

            # An exact retry reuses the cached terminal WITHOUT re-dispatching.
            second = broker.execute(copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(approval))
            self.assertEqual(first.to_record(), second.to_record())
            self.assertEqual("PASS", second.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertNotIn("use_count", adapter.permits[0])
            self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", adapter.permits[0])

            # Reusing the request identity under changed semantics is refused.
            changed = dict(request)
            changed["arguments"] = {"value": "new-semantics"}
            third = broker.execute(changed, approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", third.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "REPLAY_MISMATCH", third.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

        # The durable-state retry path refuses a consumed approval whose exact
        # provenance changed (the ``_used_approvals``/approval-state seam).
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            state_root = root / "state"
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            request = _request(request_id="durable-grant")
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-1", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)
            changed_approval = copy.deepcopy(approval)
            changed_approval["signature"] = "different-signature"
            replay = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-2", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, changed_approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", replay.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "APPROVAL_REPLAY", replay.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

    # L5 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L5_result_cleanup_pipeline_and_private_material_fail_closed(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            record = result.to_record()
            self.assertEqual(RESULT_SCHEMA, record["schema"])
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)

            cleanup = record["cleanup"]
            self.assertEqual(CLEANUP_SCHEMA, cleanup["schema"])
            self.assertTrue(cleanup["proved"])
            self.assertTrue(record["cleanup_validation"]["valid"])
            self.assertEqual([], record["cleanup_validation"]["reasons"])

            raw_result = record["raw_result"]
            self.assertEqual(
                record["raw_result_sha256"],
                hashlib.sha256(canonical_json_bytes(raw_result)).hexdigest(),
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                adapter.permits[0]["permit_sha256"], record["permit_sha256"]
            )
            self.assertTrue(record["claims_released"])

        # Value objects fail closed on banned authority-alias material.
        aliases = ("endpoint", "token", "authorization")
        for alias in aliases:
            with self.subTest(alias=alias):
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    AdapterResult(
                        True,
                        {"nested": [{alias: "private"}]},
                        {"status": "PASS"},
                        {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
                    )
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    AdapterResult(
                        True,
                        {"status": "completed"},
                        {"nested": {alias: "private"}},
                        {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
                    )
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    CleanupEvidence(
                        True,
                        {"complete": True, "members": [], "live_members": []},
                        (),
                        {"nested": {alias: "private"}},
                    )

    # L6 / A25 -------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L6_A25_full_orchestration_end_to_end_and_no_authority_leak(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            record = result.to_record()
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)
            self.assertTrue(record["cleanup"]["proved"])
            self.assertTrue(record["claims_released"])
            # Ordering: claim → arm → cleanup, then release.
            self.assertEqual(["claim", "arm", "cleanup"], events[:3])
            self.assertEqual("release", events[3])
            self.assertIn("published:TERMINAL", events)

            permit = adapter.permits[0]
            self.assertEqual(record["permit_sha256"], permit["permit_sha256"])
            self.assertNotIn("endpoint", str(permit).lower())
            # No endpoint/authority material survives into the public record.
            for banned in ("endpoint", "token", "authorization"):
                self.assertNotIn(banned, json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True).lower())
                self.assertNotIn(banned, str(result.to_record()).lower())

    # L7 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L7_fail_closed_paths_and_no_permit_leak(self) -> None:
        # (a) An adapter that does not advertise the requested action denies
        #     without dispatch.
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request(action="write")
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, {})
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

        # (b) FINDING F2B-L7-1 (note): the plan says a missing adapter surfaces
        #     ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` to the caller.  Reality: the
        #     broker catches the adapter's ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` from
        #     ``observe`` and returns a DENIED result with reason
        #     ``SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE``; the typed exception does NOT propagate.

        class UnavailableAdapter(FakeCapabilityAdapter):
            def observe(self, request):
                raise CapabilityAdapterUnavailable("fake snapshot unavailable")

        adapter = UnavailableAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, {})
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)
        self.assertFalse(adapter.permits)

        # (c) a plainly denied request (an approval that fails binding).
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        unbound = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
        unbound["snapshot_sha256"] = "0" * 64
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, unbound)
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "APPROVAL_MISMATCH", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

        # The typed exception is a real CapabilityError subclass (part of the
        # plan that DOES hold).
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(CapabilityAdapterUnavailable, CapabilityAdapterError))
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(CapabilityAdapterError, CapabilityError))

    # L10 -----------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L10_fake_capability_adapter_contract(self) -> None:
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        supported = CapabilityRequest.from_record(
            _request(action="read"), now_monotonic=0.0
        )
        unsupported = CapabilityRequest.from_record(
            _request(action="write"), now_monotonic=0.0
        )
        self.assertTrue(adapter.supports(supported))
        self.assertFalse(adapter.supports(unsupported))
        self.assertEqual(2, adapter.support_calls)

        snapshot = adapter.observe(supported)
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, CapabilitySnapshot)
        self.assertEqual(supported.request_id, snapshot.request_id)
        self.assertEqual(supported.lane_id, snapshot.lane_id)
        self.assertEqual(supported.capability, snapshot.capability)
        self.assertEqual(supported.action, snapshot.action)
        self.assertEqual(supported.resources, snapshot.resources)
        self.assertEqual(
            supported.controller_identity, snapshot.controller_identity
        )
        self.assertEqual(("read",), snapshot.capabilities["synthetic"])
        self.assertEqual(
            {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
            dict(snapshot.adapter_identity),
        )

        # fail_dispatch=True: the run terminates FAIL, dispatch raised, but the
        # adapter-level cleanup still ran and the claims were released.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter(
                {"synthetic": ("read",)}, fail_dispatch=True
            )
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("FAIL", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, result.record["dispatch_count"])
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)
            self.assertTrue(result.record["claims_released"])
            self.assertFalse(claims.held)

        # cleanup_proved=False: the run is UNCERTAIN, the claim is retained and
        # NOT released.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter(
                {"synthetic": ("read",)}, cleanup_proved=False
            )
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("UNCERTAIN", result.outcome)
            self.assertFalse(result.record["claims_released"])
            self.assertTrue(claims.retained)
            self.assertTrue(claims.held)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

OWNER = {
    "pid": 321,
    "created_utc": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "creation_identity": "fake:321",
}


class _Verifier:
    def verify(self, payload: bytes, signature: str, public_key: str) -> bool:
        return bool(payload and signature and public_key)


class _Claims:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        events: list[str],
        *,
        owner: dict[str, Any] = OWNER,
    ) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.events = events
        self.owner = dict(owner)
        self._held: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.retained = False

    @property
    def held(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [dict(self._held[key]) for key in sorted(self._held)]

    def acquire_all(self, resources: list[str], *, on_wait) -> None:
        self.events.append("claim")
        for resource in sorted(resources):
            self._held[resource] = {
                "schema": "fake-resource-claim/v1",
                "resource": resource,
                "path": str(self.root / f"{resource}.claim"),
                "owner": dict(self.owner),
                "boundary_state": "NOT_ARMED",
                "boundary_may_exist": False,
            }

    def arm_boundary(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("arm")
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "ARMED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = True
        return []

    def retain_boundary(self, *, boundary, identities) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("retain")
        self.retained = True
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "RETAINED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = False
        return []

    def release_all(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("release")
        self._held.clear()
        return []


class _OrderedAdapter(FakeCapabilityAdapter):
    def __init__(self, events: list[str], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__({"synthetic": ("read",)}, **kwargs)
        self.events = events

    def cleanup(self, permit, dispatch_result, failure):
        self.events.append("cleanup")
        return super().cleanup(permit, dispatch_result, failure)


def _request(
    *,
    request_id: str = "request-1",
    arguments: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    expiry: float = 100.0,
    resources: list[str] | None = None,
    lane_id: str = "lane-a",
    capability: str = "synthetic",
    action: str = "read",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": "orchestrator-capability-request/v1",
        "request_id": request_id,
        "lane_id": lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(OWNER),
        "capability": capability,
        "action": action,
        "arguments": dict(arguments or {"value": "safe"}),
        "resources": list(resources or ["resource-a"]),
        "expires_monotonic": expiry,
        "route": "capability",
    }


def _approval(
    request: CapabilityRequest,
    snapshot,
    *,
    approval_id: str = "approval-1",
    expires: float = 90.0,
    snapshot_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
        "approval_id": approval_id,
        "request_id": request.request_id,
        "request_sha256": request.sha256,
        "lane_id": request.lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(request.controller_identity),
        "capability": request.capability,
        "action": request.action,
        "arguments": dict(request.arguments),
        "resources": list(request.resources),
        "snapshot_id": snapshot.snapshot_id,
        "snapshot_sha256": snapshot_sha256 or snapshot.sha256,
        "policy": {"policy": "synthetic-v1"},
        "issued_monotonic": 1.0,
        "expires_monotonic": expires,
        "decision": "approve",
        "public_key": "fake-public-key",
        "signature": "fake-signature",
    }


def _broker(
    adapter,
    claims,
    *,
    now: float = 10.0,
    events: list[str] | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
) -> CapabilityBroker:
    return CapabilityBroker(
        adapter,
        approval_verifier=_Verifier(),
        policy_verifier=lambda request, snapshot, approval: True,
        identity_provider=lambda: dict(OWNER),
        claims_factory=lambda lane, request_id: claims,
        state_root=state_root,
        clock=lambda: now,
        evidence_sink=(
            lambda record: (
                events.append(f"published:{record['state']}")
                if events is not None
                else None
            )
        ),
    )


class CompatCapabilityBrokerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _approval_for(
        self, request_value: dict[str, Any], adapter: FakeCapabilityAdapter
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = CapabilityRequest.from_record(request_value, now_monotonic=0.0)
        snapshot = adapter.observe(request)
        return _approval(request, snapshot)

    # L1 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L1_request_construction_closed_shape_and_reason_codes(self) -> None:
        valid = _request()
        parsed = CapabilityRequest.from_record(valid, now_monotonic=0.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(parsed, CapabilityRequest)
        self.assertEqual("capability", parsed.route)
        self.assertEqual(("resource-a",), parsed.resources)
        self.assertEqual(
            parsed.to_record(),
            CapabilityRequest.from_record(
                parsed.to_record(), now_monotonic=0.0
            ).to_record(),
        )

        cases: list[tuple[str, dict[str, Any], str]] = [
            ("not_closed_extra", {**valid, "extra": True}, "REQUEST_NOT_CLOSED"),
            (
                "not_closed_missing",
                {key: value for key, value in valid.items() if key != "route"},
                "REQUEST_NOT_CLOSED",
            ),
            ("mixed_route", {**valid, "route": "coding"}, "MIXED_ROUTE"),
            ("empty_resources", {**valid, "resources": []}, "INVALID_RESOURCES"),
            (
                "duplicate_resources",
                {**valid, "resources": ["resource-a", "resource-a"]},
                "DUPLICATE_RESOURCE",
            ),
            ("expired", {**valid, "expires_monotonic": 0.0}, "EXPIRED_REQUEST"),
            (
                "bad_request_id",
                {**valid, "request_id": "not an identifier"},
                "INVALID_IDENTITY",
            ),
            (
                "bad_capability",
                {**valid, "capability": "bad!"},
                "INVALID_IDENTITY",
            ),
        ]
        for name, value, expected in cases:
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityDenied) as context:
                    CapabilityRequest.from_record(value, now_monotonic=0.0)
                self.assertEqual(expected, context.exception.reason_code)
                self.assertIsInstance(context.exception, CapabilityError)

    # L2 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L2_snapshot_point_in_time_capture_and_immutability(self) -> None:
        parsed = CapabilityRequest.from_record(_request(), now_monotonic=0.0)
        snapshot = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)}).observe(parsed)
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, CapabilitySnapshot)

        # The frozen dataclass rejects attribute assignment.
        with self.assertRaises(
            (dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError, AttributeError, TypeError)
        ):
            snapshot.snapshot_id = "x"  # type: ignore[misc]

        # Nested mappings are frozen MappingProxyType instances.
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot.identity, type(parsed.arguments))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            snapshot.identity["k"] = 1  # type: ignore[index]
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            snapshot.resource_identities["resource-a"]["revision"] = "nope"  # type: ignore[index]

        # The snapshot round-trips through from_record byte-stably.
        record = snapshot.to_record()
        self.assertEqual(
            record, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).to_record()
        )
        self.assertEqual(snapshot.sha256, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).sha256)

        # from_record rejects a non-closed shape / wrong schema.
        open_record = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "schema"}
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
            CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(open_record)
        wrong_schema = dict(record)
        wrong_schema["schema"] = "bogus-snapshot/v1"
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
            CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(wrong_schema)

    # L3 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L3_mediated_approval_gate_admits_and_denies(self) -> None:
        # Approve path: exact request+snapshot binding reaches a PASS.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, len(adapter.permits))

        # Deny path: decision != "approve" is refused at parse time and by
        # the broker, with NO permit ever constructed or dispatched.
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        deny = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
        deny["decision"] = "deny"
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityDenied) as context:
            CapabilityApproval.from_record(deny)
        self.assertEqual("APPROVAL_DENIED", context.exception.reason_code)

        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, deny)
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "APPROVAL_DENIED", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

    # L4 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L4_bounded_single_use_grant_actual_broker_mechanism(self) -> None:
        # FINDING F2B-L4-1 (note): the plan describes a per-permit bounded-use
        # counter on the permit value.  Reality pins a broker-enforced grant:
        # the permit is an immutable in-memory value with NO self-contained use
        # counter; bounded use is (a) idempotent terminal-result reuse for an
        # exact retry and (b) replay refusal when the request is reused under
        # changed semantics.  No per-permit counter is asserted.
        permit_field_names = {field.name for field in dataclass_fields(CapabilityPermit)}
        self.assertNotIn("use_count", permit_field_names)
        self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", permit_field_names)

        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            broker = _broker(adapter, claims)
            request = _request()
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = broker.execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)

            # An exact retry reuses the cached terminal WITHOUT re-dispatching.
            second = broker.execute(copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(approval))
            self.assertEqual(first.to_record(), second.to_record())
            self.assertEqual("PASS", second.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertNotIn("use_count", adapter.permits[0])
            self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", adapter.permits[0])

            # Reusing the request identity under changed semantics is refused.
            changed = dict(request)
            changed["arguments"] = {"value": "new-semantics"}
            third = broker.execute(changed, approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", third.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "REPLAY_MISMATCH", third.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

        # The durable-state retry path refuses a consumed approval whose exact
        # provenance changed (the ``_used_approvals``/approval-state seam).
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            state_root = root / "state"
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            request = _request(request_id="durable-grant")
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-1", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)
            changed_approval = copy.deepcopy(approval)
            changed_approval["signature"] = "different-signature"
            replay = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-2", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, changed_approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", replay.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "APPROVAL_REPLAY", replay.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

    # L5 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L5_result_cleanup_pipeline_and_private_material_fail_closed(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            record = result.to_record()
            self.assertEqual(RESULT_SCHEMA, record["schema"])
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)

            cleanup = record["cleanup"]
            self.assertEqual(CLEANUP_SCHEMA, cleanup["schema"])
            self.assertTrue(cleanup["proved"])
            self.assertTrue(record["cleanup_validation"]["valid"])
            self.assertEqual([], record["cleanup_validation"]["reasons"])

            raw_result = record["raw_result"]
            self.assertEqual(
                record["raw_result_sha256"],
                hashlib.sha256(canonical_json_bytes(raw_result)).hexdigest(),
            )
            self.assertEqual(
                adapter.permits[0]["permit_sha256"], record["permit_sha256"]
            )
            self.assertTrue(record["claims_released"])

        # Value objects fail closed on banned authority-alias material.
        aliases = ("endpoint", "token", "authorization")
        for alias in aliases:
            with self.subTest(alias=alias):
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    AdapterResult(
                        True,
                        {"nested": [{alias: "private"}]},
                        {"status": "PASS"},
                        {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
                    )
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    AdapterResult(
                        True,
                        {"status": "completed"},
                        {"nested": {alias: "private"}},
                        {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
                    )
                with self.assertRaises(CapabilityError):
                    CleanupEvidence(
                        True,
                        {"complete": True, "members": [], "live_members": []},
                        (),
                        {"nested": {alias: "private"}},
                    )

    # L6 / A25 -------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L6_A25_full_orchestration_end_to_end_and_no_authority_leak(
        self,
    ) -> None:
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            events: list[str] = []
            adapter = _OrderedAdapter(events)
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), events)
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims, events=events).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            record = result.to_record()
            self.assertEqual("PASS", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)
            self.assertTrue(record["cleanup"]["proved"])
            self.assertTrue(record["claims_released"])
            # Ordering: claim → arm → cleanup, then release.
            self.assertEqual(["claim", "arm", "cleanup"], events[:3])
            self.assertEqual("release", events[3])
            self.assertIn("published:TERMINAL", events)

            permit = adapter.permits[0]
            self.assertEqual(record["permit_sha256"], permit["permit_sha256"])
            self.assertNotIn("endpoint", str(permit).lower())
            # No endpoint/authority material survives into the public record.
            for banned in ("endpoint", "token", "authorization"):
                self.assertNotIn(banned, json.dumps(record, sort_keys=True).lower())
                self.assertNotIn(banned, str(result.to_record()).lower())

    # L7 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L7_fail_closed_paths_and_no_permit_leak(self) -> None:
        # (a) An adapter that does not advertise the requested action denies
        #     without dispatch.
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request(action="write")
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, {})
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

        # (b) FINDING F2B-L7-1 (note): the plan says a missing adapter surfaces
        #     ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` to the caller.  Reality: the
        #     broker catches the adapter's ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` from
        #     ``observe`` and returns a DENIED result with reason
        #     ``SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE``; the typed exception does NOT propagate.

        class UnavailableAdapter(FakeCapabilityAdapter):
            def observe(self, request):
                raise CapabilityAdapterUnavailable("fake snapshot unavailable")

        adapter = UnavailableAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, {})
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)
        self.assertFalse(adapter.permits)

        # (c) a plainly denied request (an approval that fails binding).
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        unbound = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
        unbound["snapshot_sha256"] = "0" * 64
        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, unbound)
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)
        self.assertEqual(
            "APPROVAL_MISMATCH", result.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
        )
        self.assertEqual(0, adapter.dispatch_calls)
        self.assertEqual([], adapter.permits)

        # The typed exception is a real CapabilityError subclass (part of the
        # plan that DOES hold).
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(CapabilityAdapterUnavailable, CapabilityAdapterError))
        self.assertTrue(issubclass(CapabilityAdapterError, CapabilityError))

    # L10 -----------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L10_fake_capability_adapter_contract(self) -> None:
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        supported = CapabilityRequest.from_record(
            _request(action="read"), now_monotonic=0.0
        )
        unsupported = CapabilityRequest.from_record(
            _request(action="write"), now_monotonic=0.0
        )
        self.assertTrue(adapter.supports(supported))
        self.assertFalse(adapter.supports(unsupported))
        self.assertEqual(2, adapter.support_calls)

        snapshot = adapter.observe(supported)
        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot, CapabilitySnapshot)
        self.assertEqual(supported.request_id, snapshot.request_id)
        self.assertEqual(supported.lane_id, snapshot.lane_id)
        self.assertEqual(supported.capability, snapshot.capability)
        self.assertEqual(supported.action, snapshot.action)
        self.assertEqual(supported.resources, snapshot.resources)
        self.assertEqual(
            supported.controller_identity, snapshot.controller_identity
        )
        self.assertEqual(("read",), snapshot.capabilities["synthetic"])
        self.assertEqual(
            {"adapter_id": "fake", "adapter_version": "v1"},
            dict(snapshot.adapter_identity),
        )

        # fail_dispatch=True: the run terminates FAIL, dispatch raised, but the
        # adapter-level cleanup still ran and the claims were released.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter(
                {"synthetic": ("read",)}, fail_dispatch=True
            )
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("FAIL", result.outcome)
            self.assertEqual("TERMINAL", result.state)
            self.assertEqual(1, result.record["dispatch_count"])
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)
            self.assertTrue(result.record["claims_released"])
            self.assertFalse(claims.held)

        # cleanup_proved=False: the run is UNCERTAIN, the claim is retained and
        # NOT released.
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter(
                {"synthetic": ("read",)}, cleanup_proved=False
            )
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            request = _request()
            result = _broker(adapter, claims).execute(
                request, self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            )
            self.assertEqual("UNCERTAIN", result.outcome)
            self.assertFalse(result.record["claims_released"])
            self.assertTrue(claims.retained)
            self.assertTrue(claims.held)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.cleanup_calls)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

"""Compatibility detection: capability-broker pipeline (Phase 2 / Area 2.B).

Pure-Python ``unittest`` suite that drives the real
``orchestrator_harness.capability_broker`` seams over fabricated in-memory
requests, approvals, snapshots, resource claims, and adapters.  No provider
subprocess is launched and no harness source module is modified.

The fixture helpers (``OWNER``, ``_request``, ``_approval``, ``_Verifier``,
``_Claims``, ``_OrderedAdapter``, ``_broker``) are copied from
``test_s5_capability_broker`` so both suites share the exact seam shapes.

Two items carry KNOWN plan-vs-reality divergences and are pinned as green
tests with the FINDING noted in the module docstring (the coordinator files
them in ``evidence/FINDINGS.md``):

* FINDING F2B-L4-1 (note): the plan says the permit is a single/bounded-use
  value with a self-contained counter.  Reality: ``CapabilityPermit`` is an
  immutable in-memory value with NO self-contained use counter; bounded use is
  enforced by the broker via (a) idempotent terminal-result reuse for an exact
  retry and (b) replay refusal (``REPLAY_MISMATCH`` / durable
  ``APPROVAL_REPLAY``).  See ``test_L4_bounded_single_use_grant``.

* FINDING F2B-L7-1 (note): the plan says pointing at a missing adapter raises
  ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` to the caller.  Reality: the broker catches
  an adapter's ``CapabilityAdapterUnavailable`` raised from ``observe`` and
  returns a DENIED result with reason ``SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE`` -- the typed
  exception does NOT propagate out of ``execute``.  See
  ``test_L7_fail_closed_paths_and_no_permit_leak``.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import json
import unittest
from dataclasses import fields as dataclass_fields
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from typing import Any

from orchestrator_harness.capability_broker import (
    APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
    CLEANUP_SCHEMA,
    RESULT_SCHEMA,
    AdapterResult,
    CapabilityAdapterError,
    CapabilityAdapterUnavailable,
    CapabilityApproval,
    CapabilityBroker,
    CapabilityDenied,
    CapabilityError,
    CapabilityPermit,
    CapabilityRequest,
    CapabilityResult,
    CapabilitySnapshot,
    CleanupEvidence,
    FakeCapabilityAdapter,
    canonical_json_bytes,
)

OWNER = {
    "pid": 321,
    "created_utc": "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    "creation_identity": "fake:321",
}


class _Verifier:
    def verify(self, payload: bytes, signature: str, public_key: str) -> bool:
        return bool(payload and signature and public_key)


class _Claims:
    def __init__(
        self,
        root: Path,
        events: list[str],
        *,
        owner: dict[str, Any] = OWNER,
    ) -> None:
        self.root = root
        self.events = events
        self.owner = dict(owner)
        self._held: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self.retained = False

    @property
    def held(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        return [dict(self._held[key]) for key in sorted(self._held)]

    def acquire_all(self, resources: list[str], *, on_wait) -> None:
        self.events.append("claim")
        for resource in sorted(resources):
            self._held[resource] = {
                "schema": "fake-resource-claim/v1",
                "resource": resource,
                "path": str(self.root / f"{resource}.claim"),
                "owner": dict(self.owner),
                "boundary_state": "NOT_ARMED",
                "boundary_may_exist": False,
            }

    def arm_boundary(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("arm")
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "ARMED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = True
        return []

    def retain_boundary(self, *, boundary, identities) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("retain")
        self.retained = True
        for record in self._held.values():
            record["boundary_state"] = "RETAINED"
            record["boundary_may_exist"] = False
        return []

    def release_all(self) -> list[str]:
        self.events.append("release")
        self._held.clear()
        return []


class _OrderedAdapter(FakeCapabilityAdapter):
    def __init__(self, events: list[str], **kwargs: Any) -> None:
        super().__init__({"synthetic": ("read",)}, **kwargs)
        self.events = events

    def cleanup(self, permit, dispatch_result, failure):
        self.events.append("cleanup")
        return super().cleanup(permit, dispatch_result, failure)


def _request(
    *,
    request_id: str = "request-1",
    arguments: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    expiry: float = 100.0,
    resources: list[str] | None = None,
    lane_id: str = "lane-a",
    capability: str = "synthetic",
    action: str = "read",
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": "orchestrator-capability-request/v1",
        "request_id": request_id,
        "lane_id": lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(OWNER),
        "capability": capability,
        "action": action,
        "arguments": dict(arguments or {"value": "safe"}),
        "resources": list(resources or ["resource-a"]),
        "expires_monotonic": expiry,
        "route": "capability",
    }


def _approval(
    request: CapabilityRequest,
    snapshot,
    *,
    approval_id: str = "approval-1",
    expires: float = 90.0,
    snapshot_sha256: str | None = None,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "schema": APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
        "approval_id": approval_id,
        "request_id": request.request_id,
        "request_sha256": request.sha256,
        "lane_id": request.lane_id,
        "controller_identity": dict(request.controller_identity),
        "capability": request.capability,
        "action": request.action,
        "arguments": dict(request.arguments),
        "resources": list(request.resources),
        "snapshot_id": snapshot.snapshot_id,
        "snapshot_sha256": snapshot_sha256 or snapshot.sha256,
        "policy": {"policy": "synthetic-v1"},
        "issued_monotonic": 1.0,
        "expires_monotonic": expires,
        "decision": "approve",
        "public_key": "fake-public-key",
        "signature": "fake-signature",
    }


def _broker(
    adapter,
    claims,
    *,
    now: float = 10.0,
    events: list[str] | None = None,
    state_root: Path | None = None,
) -> CapabilityBroker:
    return CapabilityBroker(
        adapter,
        approval_verifier=_Verifier(),
        policy_verifier=lambda request, snapshot, approval: True,
        identity_provider=lambda: dict(OWNER),
        claims_factory=lambda lane, request_id: claims,
        state_root=state_root,
        clock=lambda: now,
        evidence_sink=(
            lambda record: (
                events.append(f"published:{record['state']}")
                if events is not None
                else None
            )
        ),
    )


class CompatCapabilityBrokerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def _approval_for(
        self, request_value: dict[str, Any], adapter: FakeCapabilityAdapter
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        request = CapabilityRequest.from_record(request_value, now_monotonic=0.0)
        snapshot = adapter.observe(request)
        return _approval(request, snapshot)

    # L1 ------------------------------------------------------------------

    def test_L1_request_construction_closed_shape_and_reason_codes(self) -> None:
        valid = _request()
        parsed = CapabilityRequest.from_record(valid, now_monotonic=0.0)
        self.assertIsInstance(parsed, CapabilityRequest)
        self.assertEqual("capability", parsed.route)
        self.assertEqual(("resource-a",), parsed.resources)

    def test_L2_snapshot_point_in_time_capture_and_immutability(self) -> None:

        self.assertIsInstance(snapshot.identity, type(parsed.arguments))
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):

        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            snapshot.resource_identities["resource-a"]["revision"] = "nope"  # type: ignore[index]

        # The snapshot round-trips through from_record byte-stably.
        record = snapshot.to_record()
        self.assertEqual(
            record, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).to_record()
        )
        self.assertEqual(snapshot.sha256, CapabilitySnapshot.from_record(record).sha256)

        open_record = {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key != "schema"}

    def test_L3_mediated_approval_gate_admits_and_denies(self) -> None:

        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        request = _request()
        deny = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
        deny["decision"] = "deny"
        with self.assertRaises(CapabilityDenied) as context:
            CapabilityApproval.from_record(deny)
        self.assertEqual("APPROVAL_DENIED", context.exception.reason_code)

        result = _broker(adapter, _Claims(Path("."), [])).execute(request, deny)
        self.assertEqual("DENIED", result.outcome)

    def test_L4_bounded_single_use_grant_actual_broker_mechanism(self) -> None:
        # FINDING F2B-L4-1 (note): the plan describes a per-permit bounded-use
        # counter on the permit value.  Reality pins a broker-enforced grant:
        # the permit is an immutable in-memory value with NO self-contained use
        # counter; bounded use is (a) idempotent terminal-result reuse for an
        # exact retry and (b) replay refusal when the request is reused under
        # changed semantics.  No per-permit counter is asserted.
        permit_field_names = {field.name for field in dataclass_fields(CapabilityPermit)}
        self.assertNotIn("use_count", permit_field_names)
        self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", permit_field_names)

        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            claims = _Claims(Path(temporary), [])
            broker = _broker(adapter, claims)
            request = _request()
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = broker.execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)

            # An exact retry reuses the cached terminal WITHOUT re-dispatching.
            second = broker.execute(copy.deepcopy(request), copy.deepcopy(approval))
            self.assertEqual(first.to_record(), second.to_record())
            self.assertEqual("PASS", second.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)
            self.assertNotIn("use_count", adapter.permits[0])
            self.assertNotIn("uses_remaining", adapter.permits[0])

            # Reusing the request identity under changed semantics is refused.
            changed = dict(request)
            changed["arguments"] = {"value": "new-semantics"}
            third = broker.execute(changed, approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", third.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "REPLAY_MISMATCH", third.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

        # The durable-state retry path refuses a consumed approval whose exact
        # provenance changed (the ``_used_approvals``/approval-state seam).
        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
            root = Path(temporary)
            state_root = root / "state"
            adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
            request = _request(request_id="durable-grant")
            approval = self._approval_for(request, adapter)
            first = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-1", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, approval)
            self.assertEqual("PASS", first.outcome)
            changed_approval = copy.deepcopy(approval)
            changed_approval["signature"] = "different-signature"
            replay = _broker(
                adapter, _Claims(root / "claims-2", []), state_root=state_root
            ).execute(request, changed_approval)
            self.assertEqual("DENIED", replay.outcome)
            self.assertEqual(
                "APPROVAL_REPLAY", replay.record["denial"]["reason_code"]
            )
            self.assertEqual(1, adapter.dispatch_calls)

    def test_L10_fake_capability_adapter_contract(self) -> None:
        adapter = FakeCapabilityAdapter({"synthetic": ("read",)})
        supported = CapabilityRequest.from_record(

        with TemporaryDirectory() as temporary:
